# ViraStack AI v1 (archived, full)

> `@virastack/ai` v1.3, injects agent rules and architecture docs into a React project. Framework-aware (Next.js vs TanStack Start). v1 is archived and no longer maintained. Current version: https://virastack.com/ai/llms-full.txt

## Install

```bash
npx @virastack/ai@1 init
```

Without `@1`, npm installs v2. v1 docs: https://virastack.com/ai/docs/v1; Index: https://virastack.com/ai/v1/llms.txt; Repo: https://github.com/virastack/ai

## CLI flags

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--force`, `-f` | Overwrite existing rule files without prompting |
| `--framework nextjs\|tanstack` | Force framework instead of detecting from `package.json` |
| `--tr` | Turkish CLI prompts and success messages |

## What gets written

| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `AGENTS.md` | Agent operating guide (all agents) |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Claude Code entry point (`@AGENTS.md`) |
| `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` | Scoped coding rules (Cursor auto-loads) |
| `docs/architecture-guide.md` | Placement rules and import conventions |
| `docs/MEMORIES.md` | Project memory template |

## Rule coverage

- Architecture: core principles, feature boundaries, React best practices
- Data & state: TanStack Query (`queryOptions` factories), Zustand, API & error normalization (`ApiError`)
- UI & performance: UI components, Tailwind, forms, Core Web Vitals
- Quality: TypeScript strictness, testing expectations
- Smart isolation: only injects rules for the detected framework

## Upgrading to v2

v2 writes rules in each agent's native format (`.claude/rules/virastack/`, `.cursor/rules/virastack/`), keeps a managed block in `AGENTS.md` and tracks files in `.virastack/ai.json`. Running `npx @virastack/ai@2 init` in a v1 project removes unchanged v1 files and keeps the ones you edited. Guide: https://virastack.com/ai/docs/upgrade
